fields.label: Help
fields.options: Business rules of the EVision app. Change a value and save; it is used from the next report, map or complaint. Leave a field empty to go back to the default shown in its description.

fields.label: SLA (hours)
fields.description: A complaint restored within this many hours is SLA In, later is Out; open complaints older than this are overdue. Default 4.

fields.label: RFO counted as own fibre
fields.description: NOC reports count only complaints with this Reason for Outage (and ones with none yet). Default: Own Fiber Issue.

fields.label: Major outage days per month
fields.description: Major Outage Closure: the days with the most new cuts per team and month. Default 2.

fields.label: Day calls start (IST)
fields.description: Received from this time is a day call. Default 8:00 AM.

fields.label: Night calls start (IST)
fields.description: Received from this time is a night call, until the day start. Default 8:00 PM.

fields.label: Office full day (hours)
fields.description: First punch-in to last punch-out. Less than half of this is Absent. Default 9.

fields.label: Grace (minutes)
fields.description: Present from full day less this. Default 15 (Present from 8 h 45 min). Saved onto the office Shift Type.

fields.label: Home / office radius (metres)
fields.description: A ping this close to the employee's home or office location counts as there, unless the location has its own radius. Default 200.

fields.label: Longest gap between pings (minutes)
fields.description: Time between two pings counts only up to this gap (phone off or no signal otherwise). Default 15.

fields.label: KMZ Map: lines drawn at once
fields.description: The most route lines drawn together. If the filters match more, the map says so and draws the first ones: pick a GIS Node, Area or KMZ Path to see all of them. Too many slow the browser down.

fields.label: KMZ Map: pins drawn at once
fields.description: The most pins (buildings, ODF, poles ...) drawn together, as for lines.

fields.label: KMZ Map: shapes drawn at once
fields.description: The most shapes (area / DSA / cluster boundaries) drawn together, largest first.

fields.label: NOC map: complaints loaded
fields.description: The most complaints loaded on the NOC map for the chosen dates, newest first.

fields.label: NOC map: routes per complaint
fields.description: The most fibre routes drawn for one clicked complaint's node. More makes the map slower in the browser.

fields.label: Index rows
fields.description: Untick Show to leave a row out of the Index; change its label or colour (the colour is also used on the map). Empty label = default.

fields.label: Editable formulas
fields.description: Change a formula and save; it is checked first. Copy the Default back to undo.
